rule: A claim cannot be classed higher than its evidence. No claim is VERIFIED_* because no authenticated real-data result and no external cohort exist.

claims.claim: The historical disease figures (LOSO accuracy 0.7744, AUC 0.7941) are reproduced from the public data.
claims.status_note: Not reproduced: the data file is unavailable (HTTP 403). The figures stay HISTORICAL_UNVERIFIED_NOT_REPRODUCED.

claims.claim: The historical risk figures (accuracy 0.6304, AUC 0.6405) are reproduced from the public data.
claims.status_note: Not reproduced: the data file is unavailable.

claims.claim: The shipped artifacts' recorded counts and metrics are internally consistent (integer confusion matrices, class counts equal scaler row counts).
claims.status_note: Consistency of recorded numbers only; says nothing about whether a leakage-free evaluation produced them.

claims.claim: The majority-class baselines are 0.7538 (disease) and 0.6182 (risk), arithmetic on the recorded class counts.
claims.status_note: Arithmetic on recorded counts. The briefed alternative figure has no traceable source (see CL05).

claims.claim: The risk majority-class baseline quoted in the Phase 5 and Phase 6 briefs (a figure 0.0004 below the traceable value; stated in docs/phase5/BASELINE_AUDIT.md) is supported by the repository.
claims.status_note: Claim not supported: the briefed figure appears nowhere in code or metadata; 0.6182 is the traceable value.

claims.claim: Voice features add measurable information beyond time and baseline UPDRS for the risk target.
claims.status_note: Unknown. Requires the registered run; the result would be INCONCLUSIVE unless the p4a-1 rule is met.

claims.claim: A voice gain of about +0.03 AUC is probably not resolvable with 42 patients; about +0.09 probably is (single-reference simulation, 12 repetitions per cell).
claims.status_note: Optimistic planning figure with large Monte-Carlo error; not a result about the real data.

claims.claim: With 24 PD and 8 healthy subjects the minimum detectable disease AUC at 80% power is about 0.835.
claims.status_note: Analytic design-stage arithmetic.

claims.claim: An external validation with half-width 0.05 on sensitivity and specificity needs about 784 subjects at 25% prevalence (assumed sensitivity 0.85, specificity 0.80).
claims.status_note: Arithmetic with placeholder assumptions.

claims.claim: Either model has been validated on an independent external cohort.
claims.status_note: No cohort available; protocol drafted; blocked on data access and clinical decisions.

claims.claim: Either model is calibrated.
claims.status_note: Calibration metrics are implemented but unmeasured.

claims.claim: Any prespecified extension candidate improves on the registered baselines.
claims.status_note: Extension never run; any future result is EXPLORATORY by protocol p6-1.

claims.claim: Either model has clinical utility or may be used in patient care.
claims.status_note: No clinical claim is made. Intended use, endpoints and acceptance criteria need qualified clinical input.

claims.claim: Dataset SHA-256 hashes are pinned in the dataset manifest.
claims.status_note: No file retrieved, so no hash can be honestly recorded.

claims.claim: The shipped model artifacts carry COMPLETE training provenance.
claims.status_note: They are INCOMPLETE_DECLARED and cannot be backfilled truthfully; retraining on authenticated data would produce COMPLETE records.

claims.claim: The registered protocol p4a-1 is unchanged since it was frozen, and p6-1 is additive.
claims.status_note: Verified by hash-pinning tests; an engineering fact about the repository, not performance evidence.

claims.claim: The Phase 6 report pipeline fails closed (NOT_RUN, no numbers) when predictions or runs are missing, and refuses mismatched folds.
claims.status_note: Tested on forged data matched to stand-in artifacts.

claims.claim: The metric library agrees with scikit-learn and hand calculations.
claims.status_note: Unit tests; forged inputs.

claims.claim: Validation modules no longer install a global warning filter and run results record warning counts.
claims.status_note: Fixes finding F7.

claims.claim: The CI workflow runs the tests and the real-data validation on GitHub.
claims.status_note: Workflow written and YAML-parsed locally; never executed on GitHub because the push is not authorised.

claims.claim: Phase 6 commits have been pushed to the remote.
claims.status_note: Push returns 403 and is not authorised; commits exist locally only.
